name: Does grout repair include fixing underlying tile issues?

mainEntity.name: Does grout repair include fixing underlying tile issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grout repair primarily focuses on addressing the grout itself. However, if the grout damage is a symptom of a larger underlying issue, such as loose tiles, subfloor movement, or significant water damage, those issues would typically need to be addressed separately or as part of a more comprehensive renovation. A professional contractor performing grout repair will often inspect for these underlying problems during the initial assessment. If such issues are found, they will usually recommend a plan that includes repairing or replacing the affected tiles and addressing the structural problem before proceeding with new grout, ensuring a lasting repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grout repair focuses on grout, but professionals will identify and recommend solutions for underlying tile issues, like loose tiles or water damage, if present.
